authentication: None. The request carried no credential.

files.list-response-first-page.json: First page with limit=10: 10 places and a non-null nextPageCursor.
files.list-response-last-page.json: Last page reached by following the cursor: 2 places and a null nextPageCursor.

probes.limit: Only 10, 25, 50 and 100 are accepted (default 10). Other values return 400 {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":"Allowed values: 10, 25, 50, 100","field":"limit"}]}.
probes.cursor: An invalid cursor returns 400 with message "Invalid cursor".
probes.unknownUniverse: An unknown universe returns 200 with an empty data array.

sanitizedFields.id: Place ids replaced with distinct fakes starting at 456; ids above 2^32 kept above 2^32.
sanitizedFields.name: Replaced with fake names.
sanitizedFields.description: Non-empty description replaced with fake multi-line text; empty strings kept.
sanitizedFields.previousPageCursor: Replaced with a fake cursor of the same <placeId>_<page>_<hex32> format.
sanitizedFields.nextPageCursor: Replaced with a fake cursor of the same <placeId>_<page>_<hex32> format.

unchanged: All other values, field presence, types, nulls, item counts, and empty strings are verbatim.

rateLimitResponse.window: Fixed 60-second window of 10000 requests per caller. x-ratelimit-remaining drops by about one per request.

headers.x-ratelimit-reset: 22 (seconds left in the window; also seen 12 and 11)

rateLimitResponse.retryAfterRetryAfter: A retry after retry-after (5 s) got 429 again, with x-ratelimit-reset 3. The first 200 came only when the reset reached 0, and it started a new window (x-ratelimit-reset 53, x-ratelimit-remaining 9995).
